subject: [PATCH 17/22] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the reclaim process to common memory, which is a type of memory that can be shared among multiple nodes in a system. The changes include starting kswapd only on common nodes at boot or hotplug time, walking only common zones during direct reclaim and throttling, and using common nodes when MGLRU registers an mm or iterates/validates nodes. This approach ensures that the reclaim process is more efficient and effective by focusing on memory that can be easily shared and reclaimed.
